trusted: github-hosted Linux VM kernel and runner boundary
capsule builder and external campaign supervisor
untrusted: statement, trace, output and replay packet supplied to the verifier
trustMap.separation: The verifier is a standalone source file and imports or calls none of the builder, runner, tracer, workload or preflight implementation.
excludedClaims: malicious kernel, runner administrator or compiler resistance
arbitrary executable or arbitrary input-mechanism coverage
game, balance, strategy, P9 or product evidence

clock.name: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW
clock.finishBoundary: after every traced descendant is reaped

capsule.rootRule: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 member manifest bytes
capsule.runtimeMount: read-only bind mount verified by findmnt and a rejected write

conditional: clone only without CLONE_UNTRACED; B0 qualification only

cases.attack: overlay different bytes at the frozen corpus member after capsule-root computation
supply an outside corpus with the same basename and different bytes
retain the expected executable but execute a byte-distinct valid ELF
execute a byte-distinct request token with otherwise valid behaviour
supply V00 statement, trace and output under a fresh verifier challenge
supply cached V00 output while the current process performs no required reads
replace the current external timing fields with V00 timing
emit an in-cap child timing claim while external elapsed time exceeds the judgement cap
attempt to open a supplied undeclared alternative input path
run valid consumption while the backend deliberately omits one read event and reports one drop

decision.pass: V00 is ADMITTED; N01-N09 are REJECT for their exact expected reasons; N10 is INCONCLUSIVE for PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE; all eleven use one unchanged verifier and all caps hold.
decision.fail: Complete evidence admits any negative, rejects V00, gives a negative the wrong reason, or exceeds the single correction allowance.
decision.inconclusive: Actual-byte, lineage, invocation, event completeness or external timing binding is ambiguous outside the deliberate N10 control.
decision.correction: After this protocol is frozen, at most one batched implementation-only correction may retain the venue, backend, trust map, syscall grammar, attack matrix, caps and acceptance. It invalidates every earlier case and requires a complete eleven-case rerun.
